profile.summary:
Hi ya 🖐''

I'm a software engineer from a small town in upstate New York. Focused on merging the work ethic and craftmanship of my roots with the tech landscape where ever I may code. 

I'm a quick learner, going from not having an internet connection to getting my first internship at a startup in 3 years. I continued to gather more experience in various internships during my attendance at the University at Buffalo, studying computer engineering.

Graduating and accepting an offer to work at Lockheed Martin  as a software engineer. ✈
